items.summary: Recommendation: keep production changes and new spend paused this cycle; continue only existing measurement and incident-repair work plus one bounded finance reconciliation report. Evidence: Amazon data for 2026-09-21 shows 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission income; $0 is site-attributed and $4.92 remains aggregate/unassigned. AI usage from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-24 totals $829.87 across 4,818 calls, with 212 errors. The periods do not match, so contribution margin, ROI, payback, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Fleet outcomes show 0 proven improvements and 17 awaiting measurement. Do not treat clicks, impressions, sessions, calls, or SEO opportunity scores as revenue or margin. Minimum finance evidence needed is a same-period ledger joining site/content identifiers to shipped commission, AI cost, infrastructure/domain costs, labor allocation, and experiment exposure/outcome records. Keep SearchWoot private; its measurement and attribution gate remains blocked.

Financial review: no supported revenue forecast is present. Monthly revenue target, revenue floor, fixed costs, marketing budget, and attribution materiality threshold are blank. Site-level contribution margin cannot be calculated because site-attributed commission is $0, $4.92 is aggregate provider income, infrastructure/domain/labor costs are absent, and the revenue period is one day while AI spend covers 24 days. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable: the experiments ledger reports 0 total experiments and 0 completed outcomes, while 17 deployed improvements await measurement. Minimum measurement is one dated baseline and follow-up per change with exposure, incremental AI/infrastructure cost, site-attributed shipped commission, and outcome status.

Recommendation: produce one bounded finance and attribution reconciliation report from existing evidence only. Preserve period mismatches and unavailable cost fields as unknown; do not infer margin, ROI, payback, forecast, or causal lift.
